A woman, maybe 30s, with a gap-toothed grin has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A man, maybe 50s is showing everyone broad leaves standing tall above still water on stiff stalks by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.

It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Carlos says quietly "And you're still standing." the man in his 60s, with a shaved head, the crossing guard says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
